A '''silverfish''' in [[Matcha Flavoured]] is much weaker than in vanilla ''Minecraft'', with 1 heart of health on Easy and Normal and 2 on Hard.

== Spawning ==
Silverfish spawn from infested blocks and stronghold spawners, as in vanilla. Like other non-undead mobs, a silverfish that appears in the Overworld where it can see the sky is removed.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/spawn_mechanic/check_mob_spawn.mcfunction}}</ref>
